title: None-signer passthrough tests are tautological — do not exercise production code
description: test_e2e_no_dkim_signer_passthrough and test_relay_dkim_signing_absent construct a local None option and run a local if-branch. They do not call drain_once or try_deliver_one. They prove only a Rust stdlib tautology about Option. The production None branch is not exercised by these tests.
